# Separate Demo B's perspective capture and restore host

## Context

This is the next bounded perspective slice of #15614. Its maintenance outcome is discoverable responsibilities and smaller reading/review surfaces; the old raw-line target remains open.

## The Problem

At `dev b0e5fceb91`, seven perspective methods are interleaved with gesture, native-window and projection code in `examples/dashboard/crossWindow/DemoBWorkspace.mjs`. Capture, restore preflight, commit, remainder rendering and store-driven switching form one workflow, but its implementation spans distant parts of the host. These seven methods occupy 193 method lines before documentation and have independent unit and native consumers.

## The Architectural Reality

- Move exactly `capturePerspective`, `createSwitcherBar`, `loadPerspectiveByName`, `commitTopologyRestore`, `restoreTopologyPerspective`, `renderRestoreReport` and `syncSwitcher`.
- Their implementations are byte-identical on current dev and the approved gesture candidate `dfdee59e25`; the gesture slice is disjoint.
- `DemoBKeyboardHost.mjs` and `DemoBNativeWindowHost.mjs` establish registered Base prototype composition in this Body example. The methods still execute on the workspace; no second object owns state.
- `perspectiveStore`, `topologyCollection`, `restoreReport`, document/placement state, constructor listeners and teardown stay on the host. `WorkspaceSet` still owns atomic document publication and the host still owns projection.
- Preserve the current asymmetry: capture includes all registered workspace IDs, while restore considers main plus the first popup selected by detached panes. `commit: false` prevents a Group write but invalid reconciliation still renders its error report. After preview awaits, load reads the current collection and commit facade.
- Current plain topology-collection semantics are intentional for this move: library adoption would change clone/validation/activation behavior. The parent's [retained comparison](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/15614#issuecomment-6693132722) rejects calling that mechanical.
- Existing workspace units cover unknown names, malformed restore, unchanged active selection, parked pane identity and store-born switcher updates. `DemoBPerspectivesNL` and `DemoBPerspectiveToolsNL` exercise visible capture/restore and tour consumers.

Design authority: the extraction fulfills the parent's perspective-decomposition intent without changing its behavior. The title restoration below follows the canonical document item titles and the tab container's existing pane-header contract; Tobias surfaced the missing labels in a screenshot during candidate verification.

Prescription checked: `examples/dashboard/crossWindow/DemoBNativeWindowHost.mjs` — same-owner prototype composition fits this demo-local workflow. Euclid's independent source read confirms the family and the preflight/current-dispatch boundaries. The generic persistence/reconciler classes remain its collaborators, not a new home for demo captions or switcher controls.

### Operator-surfaced title defect

At candidate `92962b3254`, the document still names Workbench, Inspector, Timeline and Console, but an actual-class probe finds every cached pane's `header` undefined and every projected tab button's `text` null (`hidden: false`). The screenshot therefore shows missing text, not CSS-hidden labels. This predates the extraction on `dev f4781c2a97`.

`resolvePane` constructs live components without their header metadata. The layout adapter preserves live instances, and reconciliation synchronizes tab buttons from the live pane's header. Titled temporary placeholders cannot supply the missing persistent metadata.

## The Fix

Add `examples/dashboard/crossWindow/DemoBPerspectiveHost.mjs` beside the existing mixins and remove the seven implementations from the host.

Keep `restoreTopologyPerspective(topology, options)` as a host facade supplying its main/popup semantic IDs to a distinctly named internal implementation. All existing method names remain callable/overridable on the host; preserve current dispatch between them, including after awaits. Do not import DemoBWorkspace back into the mixin.

Keep library construction/subscription/destruction, `getPlacementHints`, projection, and the tour runner/reset lifecycle on the host. Preserve save replacement, invalid-input refusal, commit-before-activation ordering, structured remainder and markup escaping.

Also give both `resolvePane` creation branches `header: {text: item?.title ?? itemId}` so cached live panes own the document-derived title through perspective reconciliation. Verify the initial headers and a perspective round trip with preserved pane identity and visible browser labels.

The grid-menu CI prerequisite is tracked separately by #20564 and carried in the same PR to enable the requested sequential merge order.

## Contract Ledger

| Surface | Authority | Behavior | Refusal / fallback | Docs | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Capture/load methods | Current workspace and PerspectiveLibrary/Persistence | Same names, defaults, receipts and live host dispatch | Same unknown-name/invalid-scope/invalid-topology results | Method JSDoc | Existing workspace units and perspective NL specs |
| Topology restore/commit | Current WorkspaceSet and TopologyReconciler | Same document set, preflight, preservation list and publication ordering | No window spawned; failure does not advance active selection | Method JSDoc | Existing invalid-restore and parked-pane controls |
| Switcher/report UI | Current host references/store events | Same buttons, captions, escaped remainder and visibility | Existing absent-reference guard | Method JSDoc | Existing switcher units and visible native witnesses |
| Tab titles | Document item title and live pane header | Workbench, Inspector, Timeline and Console stay visible through reconciliation | Existing item-ID fallback | resolvePane JSDoc | Unit state and headed label assertions |
| Host lifetime | Current constructor/destroy | Same store, listeners, state and owner identity | Existing cleanup | Class JSDoc | Existing lifecycle suite |

Decision Record impact: aligned-with `neomjs/neo#adr:docking-design`; no contract or ownership amendment.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: The seven-method perspective family has one discoverable example-local home; old implementations are removed and no second state/lifecycle owner is created.
- [ ] AC-2: Existing host methods, defaults, async receipts, current override dispatch, refusal/activation ordering and rendered content within the extracted family are preserved. Its only implementation substitutions are semantic-ID parameters and the distinct internal restore name. AC-6 explicitly restores missing tab labels at pane creation.
- [ ] AC-3: Existing DemoBWorkspace/TourRunner units and the full Engine unit suite pass without weakened expectations. Add coverage only for a concrete gap exposed by the move.
- [ ] AC-4: Existing headed `DemoBPerspectivesNL` and `DemoBPerspectiveToolsNL` pass on the candidate: capture/restore, two-run tour, same-pane identity, no-window-spawn remainder and visible sibling restoration stay intact. Keep non-CI evidence separate.
- [ ] AC-5: Contextual JSDoc/`@summary` retained; report host/new-module raw and code counts and combined growth honestly, lower the existing size baseline or remove its exception when below target, and update the parent map without claiming its raw target/final matrix complete.

- [ ] AC-6: The four main-workspace tab headers show their document titles initially and after a perspective round trip, while live pane identity and popup/return behavior remain intact. A regression fails before the metadata repair and visible labels are verified in the headed journey.

## Out of Scope

TopologyLibrary adoption, persistence schema/validation changes, Engine Workspace migration, new projection or lifecycle policy, additional window support, tour presentation extraction, tour script/content changes, gesture driver changes, and parent closure.

## Avoided Traps

Do not capture collaborator snapshots or bind method copies at construction. Do not create a second controller/library or move lifecycle into the mixin. Distinct internal restore naming prevents a mixin from overwriting its facade. A smaller host is not proof of less combined code. The separately assessed tour presentation subset is only 77 method lines once reset/lifecycle stay put; it is deferred rather than filed as a second leaf.
